diagnosis: Giant cell tumour of soft tissue
legend: Low-power examination shows a multinodular proliferation of giant cell–rich nodules separated by variably sized fibrous septa.

diagnosis: Giant cell tumour of soft tissue
legend: Approximately 50% of cases exhibit metaplastic bone formation, most commonly at the periphery.

diagnosis: Giant cell tumour of soft tissue
legend: One third of cases show vascular invasion.

diagnosis: Giant cell tumour of soft tissue
legend: High-power examination reveals osteoclast-like multinucleated giant cells admixed with uniform mononuclear cells in a vascular stroma.

diagnosis: Giant cell tumour of soft tissue
legend: Characteristic multinodular architecture is seen with presence of cellular nodules separated by fibrous septa. The nodules are composed of a mixture of round to oval mononuclear cells and osteoclast-like multinucleated giant cells, with both cell types immersed in a richly vascularized stroma.
